call_points.text: Progressing on scaling casting and aluminium forging, while the Mexico facility strengthens international presence.
Consolidated capacity utilisation reached 72% in Q2FY27 on 70,925 MT production versus 62% in Q2FY26.
Global trade policies, geopolitical tensions, and supply chain uncertainties highlighted as continuing headwinds.
ROCE targeted at 12-15% this year and 20% in FY28.
FY27 capex guided at about ₹350 Cr, plus ₹20-30 Cr for the rail JV first phase.
Mexico plant production started; about ₹6 Cr revenue in Q1, significant revenue from Q3FY27.
Management will not give a full-year margin range, only promising continued quarterly improvement.
Energy and shipping costs are the main margin risk; steel is passed on with a one-quarter lag.
Management expects capacity utilization to reach 80% to 85% across forging and casting plants by the end of FY27.
The company targets gross debt reduction of ₹400 to ₹500 crores during FY27.
North American Class 8 truck demand is showing strong destocking recovery, expected to sustain for two years.
Raw material (steel) costs are entirely pass-on with a one-quarter lag.

operating_notes.text: Railway business reached 7.5% of total revenue in FY26 against 4.6% a year ago.
Trailer axle business clocked around ₹120 crores revenue in FY26, targeting doubling to ₹250 crores in FY27.
Total gross contribution from acquired subsidiaries increased to ₹752 Cr in FY26, with management targeting ₹1,000 Cr in FY27.
Inventory over-statement identified in physical verification had resulted in net adverse impact of ₹202.6 Cr after tax across FY24 and FY25.
Q1FY27 auto order wins of ₹278 Cr over four years, 82% passenger vehicle and 18% two-wheeler, all domestic; plus ₹15 Cr Metro orders.
Rail wheel JV has an 80,000-wheel confirmed order from Indian Railways plus about 25,000 wheels from JV partners, taking utilisation to about 1,10,000 wheels by end-FY28.
Mexico plant contributed about ₹6 Cr revenue in Q1FY27; significant revenue expected from Q3FY27.
Secured ₹673 Cr of order wins in Q2FY27 with a 4-year program life across CV (45%), LV (41%), Farm Equipment (13%), and EV (1%).
Total capacity utilisation reached 72% in Q2FY27 on production of 70,925 MT across installed capacity of 3,95,800 MT.
Promoters completed warrant conversion infusing ₹150 crore in Q2FY27.

timeline.summary: Ramkrishna Forgings Limited scheduled an earnings conference call on May 04, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. (IST) for FY26 and Q4FY26 results, signed by Rajesh Mundhra, ACS 12991.
Shareholders approved Mr. Chetan Rameshchandra Desai (DIN: 03595319), aged 75, as Non-Executive Independent Director for 5 years from 29 April 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,216.78 Cr, net profit ₹55.94 Cr (-72.0% YoY) (includes ₹5.19 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹61.13 Cr).
Ramkrishna Forgings Limited declared ₹1/- interim dividend per equity share for FY2025-26 on 1 May 2026.
Ramkrishna Forgings filed monitoring agency reports for preferential warrant issues for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
Ramkrishna Forgings Limited shared the audio link for its Q4 & FY 2025-26 earnings conference call held on 4 May 2026 at 4:00 PM IST via its website.
Ramkrishna Forgings hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call reporting consolidated revenue of ₹4,238 Cr and outlining FY27 debt reduction plans of ₹400-500 Cr.

Ramkrishna Forgings Limited’s **Rajesh Mundhra** (ACS-12991) announced participation in the **16th Annual Global Investor Conference ‘TRINITY INDIA 2026’** on **28 May 2026** in Mumbai, including physical investor meetings.
India Ratings downgraded long-term bank facilities to IND AA-/Stable from IND AA on elevated net leverage of 4.64x, while affirming IND A1+.
Naresh Jalan, Promoter of Ramkrishna Forgings Limited, declared no new encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26 as of 31 March 2026.

On its Q1FY27 earnings call (24 July 2026), Ramkrishna Forgings guided to a ₹8,000 Cr revenue target by FY29, one year later than earlier planned, and net debt of ₹1,900 Cr, down from ₹1,990 Cr in Q4FY26.
Ramkrishna Forgings Limited scheduled a conference call with analysts/investors on Friday, 30 October 2026 at 6:00 PM (IST) to discuss un‑audited financial results for Q2 & H1 FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,405.42 Cr (+54.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹70.59 Cr (against a loss of ₹9.5 Cr a year earlier).
Declared 1st Interim Dividend of Rs. 2/- per Equity Share of face value Rs. 2/- for FY 2026-27, effective 30 October 2026, payable within 30 days, record date 6 November 2026.
Ramkrishna Forgings reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,405 Cr (+55% YoY) with EBITDA margin of 18.2% and secured ₹673 Cr in 4-year order wins.
Ramkrishna Forgings reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,405.42 Cr and PAT of ₹70.59 Cr, supported by a ₹150 Cr promoter warrant conversion.
Ramkrishna Forgings Limited made the audio link for Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call available on 30 October 2026.
